description: PostgreSQL patch releases and CNPG's digest rebuilds of the same version merge themselves once the build workflow is green: that workflow starts the image and builds and uses a vchordrq index before anything is pushed, so a red build never reaches the registry. The cluster that consumes the image has its own Renovate and its own night window, so nothing here restarts a database by itself.

The base tag's suffix, -system-bookworm, is Renovate's compatibility group, so a proposal can never move the image to trixie. That is intended: a glibc change invalidates text indexes (see the Dockerfile).
minimumReleaseAge is deliberately unset. GHCR publishes no release timestamp, and with the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour a soak turns into 'never' for every GHCR image.

packageRules.description: A PostgreSQL major is a database upgrade with a maintenance window, never a routine bump.
